ci_support_linux_64_.yaml:
DOCKER_PLATFORM:
- linux/amd64
channel_sources:
- conda-forge
channel_targets:
- conda-forge main
docker_image:
- quay.io/condaforge/linux-anvil-x86_64:alma10
python_min:
- '3.11'

about.description:
cityImage derives Kevin Lynch's five elements of the Image of the City (paths, nodes, edges,
districts and landmarks) from OpenStreetMap, through OSMnx, or from the user's own street
networks, buildings and barriers, and returns them as GeoDataFrames with scores and Lynch
classes. It cleans street-network topology, builds dual graphs, partitions districts,
extracts barriers and scores landmarks on their structural, visual, cultural and pragmatic
salience. Optional features need extra packages: plotting (matplotlib, mapclassify),
interactive maps (folium), heights from rasters (rasterio, rasterstats) and parallel 3D
sight lines (dask, psutil).
about.summary: A computational Image of the City (Lynch's paths, nodes, edges, districts and landmarks) from geospatial data

name: cityimage
raw_meta_yaml:
schema_version: 1

context:
  name: cityimage
  version: "3.0.0"

package:
  name: ${{ name }}
  version: ${{ version }}

source:
  url: https://pypi.org/packages/source/${{ name[0] }}/${{ name }}/${{ name }}-${{ version }}.tar.gz
  sha256: 5eefe3cc011806b26ffe18d5c33d88dc859a7ced6ab4b5e44567cb48385e539b

build:
  number: 0
  noarch: python
  script: ${{ PYTHON }} -m pip install . -vv --no-deps --no-build-isolation

requirements:
  host:
    - python ${{ python_min }}.*
    - pip
    - setuptools >=77
    - wheel
  run:
    - python >=${{ python_min }}
    - geopandas >=1.1.1
    - python-igraph >=0.11.9
    - networkx >=3.3
    - numpy >=2.0
    - osmnx >=2.0.5
    - pandas >=2.2.2
    - pyproj >=3.4
    - shapely >=2.1
  run_constraints:
    - mapclassify >=2.6
    - matplotlib-base >=3.8
    - rasterio >=1.3
    - rasterstats >=0.19
    - folium >=0.14
    - dask >=2025.7.0
    - psutil >=5.9

tests:
  - python:
      imports:
        - cityImage
        - cityImage.network
        - cityImage.regions
        - cityImage.landmarks
        - cityImage.pipeline
      pip_check: true
      python_version:
        - ${{ python_min }}.*
        - "*"
  - requirements:
      run:
        - python ${{ python_min }}.*
    script:
      - python -c "import cityImage; assert cityImage.__version__ == '${{ version }}'"

about:
  homepage: https://github.com/g-filomena/cityImage
  repository: https://github.com/g-filomena/cityImage
  documentation: https://cityimage.readthedocs.io
  summary: A computational Image of the City (Lynch's paths, nodes, edges, districts and landmarks) from geospatial data
  description: |
    cityImage derives Kevin Lynch's five elements of the Image of the City (paths, nodes, edges,
    districts and landmarks) from OpenStreetMap, through OSMnx, or from the user's own street
    networks, buildings and barriers, and returns them as GeoDataFrames with scores and Lynch
    classes. It cleans street-network topology, builds dual graphs, partitions districts,
    extracts barriers and scores landmarks on their structural, visual, cultural and pragmatic
    salience. Optional features need extra packages: plotting (matplotlib, mapclassify),
    interactive maps (folium), heights from rasters (rasterio, rasterstats) and parallel 3D
    sight lines (dask, psutil).
  license: GPL-3.0-or-later
  license_file: LICENSE

extra:
  recipe-maintainers:
    - g-filomena
